title: IM-05 Molded Tray Nominal Baseline
description: Intact molded plastic tray with uniform surface finish and structural integrity matching nominal CAD specifications.
analysis: Visual metrology confirms molded plastic tray is structurally intact and within nominal tolerances. No surface scratches, cracking, or edge separation detected.

title: IM-05 Housing Surface Scratching
description: Linear abrasive scratches and scuff marks across the molded component face.
analysis: Visual metrology reveals distinct linear surface scratches along the molded exterior. Possible cause includes mechanical friction during mold ejection or tray transfer.

title: IM-05 Housing Structural Wall Crack
description: Visible longitudinal surface crack along the molded housing wall section.
analysis: Visual metrology detects structural surface cracking along the molded sidewall. Possible cause includes localized embrittlement from damp resin feedstock under injection pressure.

title: IM-05 Housing Severe Brittle Fracture
description: Through-thickness fracture and corner breakage on molded plastic housing.
analysis: Visual metrology identifies severe brittle fracture with material failure at the corner perimeter. Possible cause includes severe matrix degradation caused by moisture in un-dried resin pellets.

title: IM-05 Housing Edge Assembly Gap
description: Seam gap and perimeter parting line misalignment from uneven thermal shrinkage.
analysis: Visual metrology detects an uneven assembly gap along the component mating seam. Possible cause includes differential cooling warpage or uneven cavity pack pressure.
